objective: Replace wait-heavy future-only conversion with official-first historical screening across the already-known candidate pool, then resolve exact historical race rows from official sources in deterministic order.
priority_order: Use KEIRIN.JP registration-number profiles for exact identity and recent historical meeting screening.
For each existing candidate, scan official recent meetings in displayed chronological order and identify the first usable meeting in the opposite circumference bucket.
Resolve the exact race/vehicle assignment from official race search/race pages or official venue pages.
Admit only fields explicitly presented as historical racecard/entry/pre-race information.
Build support row provenance without requiring the official historical page fetch itself to predate that historical race.
Deduplicate by official registration number x race date x venue x race number x car number.
Recompute support gate after each completed pair.
no_cherrypick_rule: Candidate order comes from the pre-existing research candidate pool; official recent meetings are inspected in the order shown by KEIRIN.JP. Do not select a meeting based on finish, payout, odds or model performance.
expected_speed_change: Candidate discovery and historical meeting proof move from waiting for future Day1 publication to immediate official-profile/race-search processing. Future exact cards are no longer the sole path to 30-rider support.
next_execution: Batch-screen the 32 known distinct Tier1+Tier2 candidate identities against KEIRIN.JP recent histories.
Prioritize riders with an immediately visible opposite-circumference historical meeting.
Resolve exact official race rows and create historical support receipts where the official racecard/entry evidence is sufficient.
Expand beyond the 32 only if the 30-rider gate remains short after deterministic screening.
